newsitem.title: USA: Delta introduces summer fare sale.
newsitem.headline: Delta introduces summer fare sale.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc said on Tuesday it lowered prices on regular advance purchase excursion fares on some routes as part of a summer fare sale.
Fares were available for travel throughout the peak summer season in the United States and Canada, the airline said.
Tickets could not be purchased later than May 20, it said, and the new round-trip sale fares were available for travel through Oct. 8.
They required seven days advance purchase and a Saturday night stay, it said. Other restrictions applied, it said.
